reason_codes.meaning: The complete exact Plan contract and every deterministic authority binding pass; only its immutable reference may advance.
No complete Reconstruction Plan candidate is available.
The candidate is not the exact closed ADR 0084 Plan contract.
The candidate requests an operation outside the admitted ADR 0082 registry and requires Source Contract Review.
The Plan does not bind the exact untrusted semantic candidate selected for validation.
No accepted Hong Kong Legislation Legal Desk decision binds this exact Plan.
The selected HKeL base is not proved to be the latest eligible applicable bilingual base.
The event chain does not completely account for every operative event from base to cutoff.
The legal execution order is not completely proved.
The cutoff and applicability branch are not exact.
The affected, governing, dependent, or independent-boundary closure is incomplete or inconsistent.
Another Plan overlaps this dependency closure at the same cutoff.
Authentic source-unit ownership is incomplete or inconsistent.
English and Traditional Chinese authentic-language evidence or stream rules are incomplete.
The two authentic-language streams do not establish one aligned legal result.
Operation IDs, sequence, selectors, parameters, or closed-registry inventory are inconsistent.
An operation or effect-only event lacks its complete event and evidence bindings.
An atomic group is not dependency closed.
The Plan references evidence or input outside its declared immutable inventory.
Final deterministic revalidation failed; no operation may execute.
